confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.name: INSPIRE technical guidance for GML files
verified_facts: HMLR supplies INSPIRE polygons as GML captured against British National Grid.
HMLR warns that reprojection from BNG to WGS84 can shift some features by up to 15 metres depending on conversion calculations.
semantic_limits: Reprojection error is horizontal geometry risk, not vertical terrain accuracy.
Reprojected web-map geometry must not replace native BNG geometry for exact spatial matching.

candidates.name: OS NGD coordinate reference systems
verified_facts: OS distinguishes BNG EPSG:27700 from BNG plus ODN Height EPSG:7405.
EPSG:27700 is horizontal only while EPSG:7405 includes an ODN vertical reference.
semantic_limits: A compound CRS declaration does not prove survey-specific geoid/transformation lineage.
CRS metadata is reference-system evidence, not an elevation observation.

candidates.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
verified_facts: OSTN15 is the definitive OS transformation between ETRS89 and OSGB36 National Grid.
OSTN15 uses a 1km transformation grid and bilinear interpolation of easting/northing shifts.
semantic_limits: OSTN15 is a horizontal datum transformation and must not be confused with OSGM15 vertical transformation.
Transformation-model accuracy is not parcel terrain-model accuracy.

candidates.name: Ordnance Datum Newlyn
verified_facts: OS defines ODN as orthometric height relative to the Newlyn tide-gauge datum.
OS notes historical bench marks can be affected by subsidence and the bench-mark network has not been maintained since the 1970s.
semantic_limits: ODN datum definition is not proof of a parcel survey's transformation lineage.
Historic bench-mark accuracy must not be transferred to EA raster pixel accuracy.

candidates.name: Coordinate reference systems - cartography guide
verified_facts: OS explains that the same numeric coordinates represent different physical positions in different CRSs.
OS states ETRS89 GNSS positions should pass through OSTN15 to become OSGB36 National Grid coordinates and defines ODN as the GB vertical zero reference.
semantic_limits: Rendering or CRS labelling without the correct transformation is not valid positional evidence.
Horizontal CRS conversion does not establish a vertical observation.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
verified_facts: EA describes the time-stamped point cloud as 3D x/y/z points from which site-specific DTM and DSM time-stamped raster products are derived.
EA warns a historic surface-model survey may not always have a matching archived point cloud.
semantic_limits: Point-cloud availability must not be assumed from raster availability.
Raw point classification is not automatically the final manually edited DTM surface.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: EA time-stamped DTM tiles are available at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on survey requirements and are referenced to ODN on the OS Grid.
EA explicitly requires metadata-index lookup for survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model at a location.
semantic_limits: Nominal resolution is not parcel accuracy.
A time-stamped tile is not usable as exact parcel lineage until the correct spatial metadata record is matched.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: EA time-stamped DSM tiles include objects such as buildings and vegetation as well as terrain.
Their metadata index records survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model for available coverage.
semantic_limits: DSM values remain excluded from bare-earth parcel extrema.
DSM survey lineage can support provenance but not replace DTM sampling.

candidates.name: National Polygon dataset technical specification
verified_facts: HMLR National Polygon records include a unique Poly_ID, Title_No, insert/update dates, version and record status.
HMLR states INSPIRE Index Polygons are a subset with simpler attributes.
semantic_limits: Richer polygon attributes improve lifecycle/provenance checks but do not make an index polygon a determined legal boundary.
Paid National Polygon data remains optional for this workflow.

candidates.name: National Grid and the OSGB36 TRF
verified_facts: OS explains that OSTN15 with OS Net ETRS89 coordinates now defines National Grid positions.
OS publishes control-station relative-accuracy context within OSGB36.
semantic_limits: Control-network accuracy is not the accuracy of HMLR polygons or EA terrain pixels.
Control statistics must not be promoted to parcel-specific uncertainty.
